name: Thaloria Born To Die
source: Two years have passed since Lumi claimed his destiny and disappeared into the wilderness, driven by a devastating loss that still shadows him and fuels his relentless training. At last, Remy and the revolutionary army have completed their preparations, united in their resolve to challenge the oppressive rule of Eralith and confront the queen and her loyalists. While the bulk of their forces marches toward the capital in open defiance, Lumi and Remy journey to Solarar to seek the third monarch. The final war is at hand, and the fate of Thaloria will soon be decided.
translation: 自从卢米宣布自己的命运并消失在荒野中以来，两年过去了，毁灭性的损失仍然笼罩着他，并激励着他坚持不懈的训练。最后，雷米和革命军队完成了准备工作，团结一致，决心挑战伊拉里斯的压迫统治，对抗女王和她的忠诚者。当他们的主力公然挑衅地向首都进军时，卢米和雷米前往索拉拉寻找第三位君主。最后的战争即将来临，塔洛里亚的命运即将决定。
